review_evidence: Grep over all 438 listed files: 11332 declaration lines, 2209 theorem/lemma lines; 430 files have at least one declaration.

conformance/HexECPP/Fixture512.lean (772367 B, largest): read head and tail; it defines Hex.ECPP.Fixture512.child and .cert (a PARI-derived ECPP primality certificate as a Lean def) and ends with #guard Hex.ECPP.check on the cert; formal certificate data, retained.
conformance/HexECPPMathlib/HasseAudit.lean (330 B) read completely: #guard_msgs over #print axioms Hex.ECPP.hasse_sq_zmod; names a theorem, retained.
conformance/HexECPPMathlib/SoundnessAudit.lean (504 B) read completely: #print axioms checks of Hex.ECPP.natPrime_of_check and natPrime_of_checkAt; retained.
conformance/HexRCF/AdmissionConformance.lean read completely: run_meta axiom audit over HexSturmMathlib.check_sound, query_sound, Tarski.check_rootSum and FieldBuild soundness theorems; retained.
conformance/HexRationalFn/Domains.lean read completely: four scoped instances (ZMod64.Bounds and PrimeModulus for 2 and 7) proved by decide; the grep missed the scoped modifier; retained.

conformance/HexRealAlgebraic/Conformance.lean and ReprChecks.lean read completely: #guard statements on RealAlgebraicNumber arithmetic, sqrt, roots, floor/ceil and Repr round trips; executable formal checks, retained.

conformance/HexSturmMathlib/Replay/Baseline.lean read completely: imports, public section, namespace and open only; no declarations, but open/namespace take it outside the pure-import class and no auxiliary channel is verified; retained.
conformance/HexSturmMathlib/Replay/SemanticsBaseline.lean read completely: six public imports and a doc comment only; pure import aggregator kept primary-eligible under FILTER-007.
summary: Surveyed all 438 listed .lean files (Hex/BenchOracle, Hex/Conformance, HexHermiteMathlib, HexMvGcd, HexMvHensel, HexNumberField*, HexRealFormula, HexRealRoots, and conformance/*; sizes 330 B to 772 KB). A line-start grep for theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque (with private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/meta/public modifiers) matched 11332 declaration lines in total, 2209 of them theorem/lemma lines; 8 files had zero matches and I read all 8 completely, plus the head and tail of the largest file conformance/HexECPP/Fixture512.lean. Every zero-match file holds formal content (scoped instances, #guard statements about real algebraic numbers, run_meta axiom audits, #print axioms checks of named soundness theorems) or is an import/open-only baseline module whose navigation signal has no verified auxiliary channel (FILTER-007, FILTER-004 clause 1 unmet). All files stay retained.
